description: Returns the unsigned transaction to add, change or remove per-token lending limits. A limit cannot be set below what is already in active loans for that token.

limits.description: Tokens and the max USDC to lend against each

asset.description: Token contract address on Base (preferred) or its symbol, e.g. WETH, VIRTUAL, esALB

limit_usdc.description: Max USDC to lend against this token; 0 removes it

name: build_set_limits
title: Prepare per-token lending limits
